text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-It's alright. This was meant to be 
practice anyway.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It comes down to positioning, arm 
strength, and a bit of luck. Skill alone 
won't guarantee a catch— which is kind of 
like fishing... wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take our revenge again...! If it's 
you, Trainer-san, you'll definitely 
improve...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
